name: Vicious Mockery

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Creature seen or heard makes WIS save; failure Psychic and Disadvantage on next attack through end of target next turn; hearing-only target eligibility and character scaling.

rules.text: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see or hear within range.
The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).
